mapper.select: select , coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), nullif(u.real_name, ''), u.username) as teacher_name, d.stage_name as stage_name, d.day_number as day_number from sys_class_schedule s left join sys_user u on u.id = s.teacher_id left join sys_course_detail d on d.id = s.course_detail_id where s.class_id = #{classId} and s.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} limit 1
select count(1) from sys_class_schedule where class_id = #{classId}

mapper.update:

#{id}
mapper.select: select s.teacher_id as teacherId, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as teacherName, s.schedule_date as scheduleDate, s.class_id as classId, c.class_period as classPeriod from sys_class_schedule s left join sys_user u on u.id = s.teacher_id left join sys_class c on c.id = s.class_id where s.teacher_id is not null and s.class_type = 'CLASS' and s.schedule_date >= #{startDate} and s.schedule_date <= #{endDate} order by s.teacher_id asc, s.schedule_date asc, s.class_id asc, s.id asc

select s.id as scheduleId, s.class_id as classId, c.class_period as classPeriod, c.campus_id as campusId, camp.campus_location as campusName, s.class_type as classType, s.course_content as courseContent from sys_class_schedule s inner join sys_class c on c.id = s.class_id left join sys_campus camp on camp.id = c.campus_id where s.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and s.class_type in ('CLASS', 'SELF_STUDY') order by c.campus_id asc, c.id asc, s.id asc
